signInBody: Sign in to see how AI answers describe your brand, which sites they cite, and what to fix next.
signUpBody: Create your account, then set up your brand in a few steps. Your first AI visibility check runs right after setup.
signUpNote: After you create your account, we will ask for your website so we can set up your brand. It takes a few minutes.
panelTitle: See what AI says about your brand
panelBody: AiSearchOwl tracks the questions people ask AI, shows whether your brand is mentioned, and tells you what to fix next.
panelPointOne: See how often ChatGPT and Perplexity mention your brand. Gemini and Claude are paid add-ons.
panelPointTwo: See which sites AI cites, and where competitors appear instead of you.
panelPointThree: Get a clear plan of pages to fix and mentions to win.
panelNote: Your sign-in is handled by Clerk. AiSearchOwl never sees or stores your password.
setupTitle: Login is not switched on yet
setupBody: This screen is ready, but the Clerk keys are missing, so no one can sign in or create an account yet. Add the keys below, then restart the dev server.
setupStepOne: Go to dashboard.clerk.com and create an application (or open your existing one).
setupStepTwo: Open “API keys” and copy the Publishable key and the Secret key.
setupStepThree: Paste them into .env.local in the project root, next to API_BASE_URL, the variable names are listed above.
setupStepFour: Restart the dev server (stop it, then run npm run dev again). This page will then show the sign-in form.
